behavior: dotf gate knowledge passes every case of tests/check-knowledge-gate.bats through the event shim
dotf gate spec passes every case of the spec-gate suites through the event shim
The gates make no network call: no token, and a gh on PATH that records any call
Each fleet rule has a stable id, good and bad fixtures, and exceptions scoped to rule and path with reason and issue
dotf lint fleet --fleet lists findings per repository; rules documented in one runbook section
